record.name: Grain
record.one_liner: AI meeting recorder and transcript assistant that captures calls, generates notes, and provides APIs and MCP servers for AI workflows.
record.access_note: Developers can sign up for a free plan and generate a personal access token directly from account settings.
record.api_note: The Grain API lets developers read meeting data, manage recordings, and receive real-time events from Grain programmatically.

evidence.quote: Grain supports three authentication methods depending on your use case.
Personal API tokens are generated in Account settings → Integrations → Personal API. They are available on every plan.
The Grain API lets developers read meeting data, manage recordings, and receive real-time events from Grain programmatically.
Grain's MCP (Model Context Protocol) server gives AI assistants direct access to your meetings
